# Fixture attribution

The `*.json` files in this directory are unmodified copies of ball-by-ball match files from
[Cricsheet](https://cricsheet.org/), released under the
[Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0 (ODC-By 1.0)](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/by/1-0/).

Source archive: `all_male_json.zip` (downloaded 2026-10-28, see `data/raw/2026-10-28/MANIFEST.json`).

| File | Date | Why it is here |
|---|---|---|
| `1023647.json` | 2017-01-25 | super over, wide, no-ball |
| `1383095.json` | 2023-07-26 | multi-wicket delivery, wide, no-ball |
| `1001349.json` | 2017-02-17 | ordinary match (wide, no-ball, no super over) baseline |
